summary: Single-line __cdecl allocation wrapper: forwards the requested size a1 plus the global allocation context dword_8D41B0 into NhMalloc and returns the resulting pointer. ABI evidence names the function as a malloc-style entry point; the wrapper centralizes the allocator-global argument so callers only pass a size.

operations.description: Pass the size a1 through as the first argument to NhMalloc.
Call NhMalloc(a1, dword_8D41B0), reading the global allocation context dword_8D41B0 (read-only in this function).
Return the NhMalloc result pointer unchanged as the allocated block.

Widely used by allocator/string utilities, e.g. AllocAndZeroInit (0x00517E43), MallocWrapper (0x00519346), StringMallocCopy (0x00564690), StringAllocCopy (0x00598600), AudioStreamBufferRead (0x00535390) and MemoryAllocatorInit (0x005957BD), as the standard sized-allocation path.

unresolved: Meaning of dword_8D41B0 (allocation pool/tag/context) is not recoverable from this packet.
NhMalloc contract (alignment, failure behavior, ownership of returned pointer) is defined in its own function, not here.
